title: neurotheca loeselioides subsp. robusta
intro: Neurotheca loeselioides subsp. robusta, commonly known as Robusta, is a plant species within the Gentianaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Neurotheca loeselioides subsp. robusta include its potential to lower blood sugar levels and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the secretion of insulin and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Neurotheca loeselioides subsp. robusta include iridoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
